password=[a['password'] for a in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if a['account_name']=='phone'][0]
login=apis.phone.login(username='4436271690', password=password)
access_token=login['access_token']
print('access_token_prefix', access_token[:20])

updates=[]
# go-to-sleep alarm id determined earlier
go_to_sleep_id=122
res1=apis.phone.update_alarm(alarm_id=go_to_sleep_id, access_token=access_token, time='22:30', enabled=True)
updates.append(('go_to_sleep', go_to_sleep_id, res1))

# disable all other alarms that are currently enabled (from earlier fetch)
for alarm_id in [120,121,126]:
    res=apis.phone.update_alarm(alarm_id=alarm_id, access_token=access_token, enabled=False)
    updates.append(('disable', alarm_id, res))

for item in updates:
